gaps.sentence: They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: I stand ___ my decision — it was the right one.
gaps.explanation: stand by something = continue to support it; stand by somebody = help and support them.

gaps.sentence: Small suppliers are struggling to keep their heads ___ water.
gaps.explanation: 'Keep your head above water' = just manage to survive, especially financially.

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: The factory laid ___ two hundred workers.
gaps.explanation: lay off = dismiss workers because there is not enough work.

gaps.sentence: How do you account ___ the sudden change of plan?
gaps.explanation: account for = explain the cause of.
